name: Manifesto
line: Three statements, 'A hazard is not a risk.', 'Sure is not big.' and 'A population is not a person.', each set huge in Bodoni Moda on a pinned white page and assembled word by word as you scroll, with 'not' in ultramarine; then the explorers, Code Against Cancer and the games as a typographic index of large rows.
notes: Each statement is supported only by CONTENT.md text: the Group 1 definition, the tobacco and processed-meat lesson with its exact figures, and the caveat about populations. Figures and the index numbers use Bodoni Moda at a low optical size (opsz 11 to 14) so their hairlines stay legible; the statements use the display optical size. The network drawings are the explorers' own SVGs, printed in ultramarine with a CSS blend (grayscale + screen), so they work without JavaScript. Without JavaScript or with reduced motion the statements are static and fully set. Bodoni Moda is Latin-only; Karla is Latin-only (no Cyrillic).
